description: This source file implements functions for copying files and file descriptors, including copying file contents, copying file times, and handling file permissions and error conditions.

methods.name: int copy_fd(int ifd,int ofd)
methods.description: Copies data from an input file descriptor to an output file descriptor, handling errors during read/write.

methods.name: int copy_times(const char * dst,const char * src)
methods.description: Copies the access and modification times from the source file to the destination file.

methods.name: int copy_file(const char * dst,const char * src,int mode)
methods.description: Copies a file from source to destination, setting permissions, and handling errors.

methods.name: int copy_file_with_time(const char * dst,const char * src,int mode)
methods.description: Copies a file and its timestamps from source to destination.

ctags.name: copy_file
ctags.pattern: /^int copy_file(const char *dst, const char *src, int mode)$/

ctags.name: copy_file_with_time
ctags.pattern: /^int copy_file_with_time(const char *dst, const char *src, int mode)$/
